data.title: bn-3jz: Document cmusic game integration workflow
data.description: Review the build-cart skill and project/testing docs for accurate .cmusic integration guidance, SFX/music namespace migration, and build/check acceptance sequencing.

data.body: LOW: This command block mixes working-directory conventions: audio/game.cmusic is relative to an already-entered project, while every following command addresses my-game from its parent. From the parent directory used by the rest of the block, the first command fails unless an unrelated top-level audio directory exists. Use my-game/audio/game.cmusic, or consistently switch the whole block to project-relative dot/build paths.

LOW: Step 4 says to confirm audio_events, but the fresh-checkout command directly below omits --audio-events and therefore emits no sequencer evidence. Add --audio-events to this console run example, matching docs/project-workflow.md, so the copy-paste workflow actually proves that remapped gameplay cues stay outside the music phrase bank.
Addressed: the project run example now includes --audio-events, matching the runtime evidence requirement.
Addressed: the bundle playback example now consistently uses my-game/audio/game.cmusic.
